content.text: Intent
A register of natural persons, each recorded with a name and an age. It serves any signed-in user of the deployment who needs to create, browse and edit person records.
Scope
In: a Person entity with name and age; its standard search screen and edit form.
Out: relationships between persons, addresses, contact details, identity documents, and any linkage to legal entities or CDM Party — none requested.
Out: age auto-derivation from a date of birth — only an explicit age is held.
Scenarios
None — the entity supports plain create/edit/browse through its standard screens; no ordered journey beyond that is requested.
Requirements
None — every rule is carried by the bean table: name is required, age is a whole number between 0 and 150. The platform enforces and tests these.
Data model
bean: Person
No relationships. Age is held as stated by the author, not derived from a date of birth; it may be left empty when unknown.
Artifacts:
Entity descriptor
· Default form — not yet saved (see below).
User interface
The bean's search screen and edit form — a simple register: list of persons with name and age columns, one row edited in the standard detail form.
Dependencies
None — this spec relies on no other spec, existing entity or external system.
Constraints

Considered, none apply: authorization (platform default — any signed-in user), performance, volume, availability, audit, privacy, locale, cost. Note: name and age are personal data; the platform's standard audit trail covers edits.
Acceptance criteria
None — the platform's generated tests cover the table rules (name required; age within 0–150).
Migration & compatibility
None — new entity, nothing to migrate; no existing rows, users or callers are affected.
Artifacts
A Person entity with a person search screen and edit form.
Derived from the Data model
Implied by the bean blocks in the Data model and regenerated by the platform - do not edit this block; author above it what the catalog cannot derive.

Person - persistence.entity (persistence): The entity class with its builder, its descriptor + jsontype entry, its migration and table, and its tests; the descriptor is authored at spec time as the bean's entity-descriptor attachment (entity_descriptors/{qualified-descriptor-name}.json).
Person - observer.sheet (observer): The observer sheet: the entity's only remote surface, reads and writes.

Person - ui.defaultForm (ui): The default form of one row, rendered wherever the row is viewed or edited: its layout JS, authored at spec time as the spec's ui/{qualified-descriptor-name}.js attachment and shipped beside the entity class.
Person.age - validation.rule (persistence): min(0) - enforced on save and covered by a generated test
Person.age - validation.rule (persistence): max(150) - enforced on save and covered by a generated test
Open Questions
None — the request settles the fields. Whether Person should link to CDM's Party was settled from the live catalog: the deployment serves no CDM party entities, so Person is a standalone register.
